scripts.dev:check: node -e "console.log('dev:check is now platform-aware. On Linux/macOS, run \"npm run dev:check:linux\" to inspect the Vite dev server.');"
scripts.dev:check:linux: bash -lc 'echo "[proc]" && (ps aux | grep -E "vite|node.*5173" | grep -v grep || echo "no-vite-process") && echo && echo "[listen]" && (ss -ltn | grep 5173 || echo "no-listener-5173") && echo && echo "[http]" && (curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:5173 || echo "curl-failed")'
